lines: Asagi-sensei had called me to the headmistress's office.
Fuma-kun, the UFS contacted us regarding a joint operation.
Right from the start I had a bad feeling.
Is that masked woman involved again?
Apparently not this time. You know those combat drones developed by the UFS, right?
Yes, since I've fought against them a few times.
In fact, I knew them not only from fighting against them, but also from the "part-time job" that I had done with Sakura.
Of course, I had kept that a secret from Asagi-sensei.
So, what is this joint operation?
Apparently a developer ran away from a UFS research facility and took all the data with him.
Moreover, he is now trying to sell that data to the mafia in Tokyo Kingdom.
So the UFS asked us to help them find the researcher and to get back the data. ...That's the gist of it.
Asagi-sensei explained up to that point and waited for my reaction.
She had a cynical smile on the edge of her lips.
Why is the UFS deliberately trying to involve Taimanin in dealing with their scandal? That's too suspicious.
Yes, I'm sure there's something more to it. But we will intentionally act as though we are going along with it.
That's why I chose you for this mission, since you are good at assessing situations. Moreover, there is also the matter from before.
Your "part-time job." Did you think I hadn't noticed?
So she had known all about it.
It was just as expected from Asagi-sensei, but I was still speechless. I suppose there was nothing to do but accept the mission.
Th-The developer who ran away, is he a normal human?
It was a strange question, but among UFS developers, there were more than a few brawny cyborgs.
According to the data that the UFS sent to us... yes, he is. Here, look at this.

In the documents that Asagi-sensei handed me was a picture of a man of Japanese descent, with an expressionless face that had no distinguishing features. He also had a strange name, with both parts appearing to be surnames.
I, too, thought that name was weird... but there's one more matter of concern.
Look at this document. It's the profile of the person who will join the operation with the Taimanin.
When I saw the picture in the additional document she handed over, I was at a loss for words.
You seem to know her already.
How could I not know her? She's...
One of the worst mass murderers the world had ever seen.
She had killed more than 100 people, and those were only her known victims.
She had killed people regardless of their gender or age, even babies, and her atrocities were said to have sown fear throughout the UFS.
Since the culprit had killed not only humans, but also demons, it had been imagined that it was a powerful demon or someone with superhuman power.
But at the end of a major investigation by the entire UFS, the individual arrested had not been a demon or someone with superhuman power, but a normal human.
And she had even been working as a teacher.
The stage for her final act of violence had been the school where she worked. It was broadcasted to the whole UFS over the internet. By her.
During class, she had started by suddenly decapitating a female student who had asked a question, and then she proceeded to kill students and teachers one after another.
She slaughtered several police officers who had rushed in, and she took a few bullets herself, but didn't die despite that.
Fascinated viewers from all over the world had breathlessly watched the whole story until she was arrested, completely covered in blood. I also had been one of those viewers.
After the arrest, an exceptionally quick trial had been held and the decision had been, of course, the death penalty.

If I'm not mistaken, it was to be carried out the same dayー
Shouldn't she have been executed?
It seems that was all for show.
In fact, her talent for murder was highly valued, and she secretly became a pet of the UFS. Her code name is No.16, Sonia the Homicidal Maniac.
So this is a mission that undoubtedly has some kind of ulterior motive behind it, and on top of that you're putting me with this psychopathic murderer.
I considered that, and so I arranged for someone to take a support role.
Suddenly, a single flower petal floated past, right in front of me.
After being distracted for a moment, I could feel somebody standing behind me.
Looks like we'll be teaming up again, Fuma-kun.
Hey, didn't I tell you to call me Kosaka-sensei at school?
The one who had appeared was Kosaka Shizuru.
She was an English teacher at Gosha Academy and also a highly-skilled Taimanin called "Shizuru the Flower."
She was a devious person who had expertly used me as a decoy when I had previously been dragged around by the strange demons Lilim and Minasaki.
It had been my fault as well though, because I was skipping English class all the time and therefore hadn't known the face of Kosaka-"sensei."
Feeling bitter about that, I still wasn't attending English class even now.
Shizuru looked at my vague expression and smiled amusedly.
Ehehe, you can call me Shizuru this time as well though. I don't want you to be weirdly on edge just because I'm a teacher at Gosha Academy.
Just treat me as one of your subordinates from beginning to end. What you personally want to call me is up to you, hehe.
Asagi-sensei... I'm starting to get a bad feeling about this.
Maybe that's just what we need. I'll leave the selection of the other personnel to you. Well then, thanks in advance.
Asagi-sensei patted me on the shoulder.
We entered Tokyo Kingdom right away.
I had come to this abandoned city floating in Tokyo Bay just a while ago with Sakura during our "part-time job."
This time it was a proper Taimanin mission, but there was also a decidedly-not-proper bad apple with us.
Hehehe, Tokyo Kingdom. The feeling of this city... I don't hate it.
All around, the smell of blood and death is floating in the air. It gives me a rush.
Sonia the Homicidal Maniac stood in the middle of the downtown area, looking truly happy.
We had already finished our introductions.
I knew her appearance from that tragic video and the documents, but the actual person was cloaked in an air of danger that exceeded my imagination.
To use an analogy, she was like an unsheathed blade constantly dripping with blood. Honestly, just standing next to her sent a chill down my spine.
Until her crimes had come to light, she had been quietly working as a teacher, but now not even a trace of that could be felt.
Ughhh, why do we have to be with someone like her... I wish I could've stayed home too...
This always happens when I get involved with you, Fuma... ugghhh...
Shikanosuke was the farthest from Sonia, listing off his complaints.
By "stayed home" he was talking about Hebiko.
Due to the fact that the wounds she had suffered at Chaos Arena weren't fully healed yet, she wasn't participating in the mission this time.
...So, Sonia. You and the UFS are the lead on this mission. Tell us your plans.
The mission was called a joint operation, but right now only Sonia was with us.
Other UFS members were already undercover somewhere in the city.
Sonia scoffed as if we were fools.
All I was told from above was that I was to work with you guys.
Normally I work on my own and do things my way, so I would usually refuse to work together with someone...
But you Taimanin seemed a bit more interesting compared to the UFS cowards.
So, what do you intend to do, Captain? For the record, I hate mucking about.
If you go on and on about annoying shit, you'll end up as dead bodies even before that runaway researcher does.
The clack of Sonia's footsteps rang out as she approached.
Surely, if she wanted to, she was close enough to slit my throat.
H-Hey, what are we going to do?
This psychopathic killer doesn't seem to have the slightest interest in listening to what we say. I don't want to get killed by someone like her.
Shikanosuke had already been far away, and now he spoke from even farther away.
(He's too much of a coward... Not like this was the start of that though.)
Meanwhile, Shizuru was smiling calmly as always.
Unsurprisingly, she didn't seem uneasy even in front of Sonia, but this time she was here as my subordinate and was waiting for my orders.
Umm... Sonia, you don't know how the UFS will operate, right?
We don't know the whereabouts of the runaway developer. But searching for a single person in this city would take too much time and effort.
And? That doesn't sound like fun at all.
Sonia creaked her iron claws as if to say she might use them. It was a nasty sound.
I obtained one piece of information. A large black market auction will be held in the city soon.
If the researcher plans to sell the data to the mafia, there's a good chance he'll make an appearance there.
How about we start by confirming when and where this auction will be held and then take part in it?
Hmph... A black market auction, huh?
I gulped, and then delivered the clincher I had prepared.
It's a black market auction held by an underground organization. Among the participants, there will be loads of villains whose deaths won't bother anyone, and they might even be better off dead.
Until we secure the researcher, we don't have to worry about collateral damage due to unforeseen circumstances.
Hehe, from the first moment I haven't cared about how many people die as collateral damage. But whatever. I'll follow your plan.
Sonia snapped her iron claws shut to indicate her acknowledgement.
I was relieved by her response.
Then let's split into two groups and gather information. The teams will beー
Whenever I see a beautiful woman or a cute kid, I just want to chop them up.
I-I'm terribly shy around strangers! Right?! Are you listening, Fuma?!
Sonia's remark, which didn't sound like a joke at all, and Shikanosuke's remark, which represented the height of cowardice, left me feeling fed up.
Sonia with me. Shizuru with Shikanosuke.
And with that we split into two teams.
Being alone with the Homicidal Maniac... I wasn't happy at all.
For now, let's go and see an information broker in the city. What do you think, Sonia?
I told you, I hate slow progress. ...Over there looks good.
Sonia looked around and then walked straight toward a building that looked like a yakuza-run office.
What are you planning to do?
I'm going to ask someone who knows.
(Is she planning to pretend to be a prostitute that was called to the office or something and extract information?)
It appeared that I, having thought such a thing, wasn't taking a killer's thought process seriously.
Huh? Who the hell are you!?
Sonia suddenly cut down the gangster that had come out.
I didn't even have time to stop her.
The gangsters inside were in an uproar, and each grabbed a weapon and tried to fight back.
Hurry up and come here. I'm gonna kill you all♪
Without hesitation, Sonia rushed into the office and began killing these gangsters she didn't even know one by one.
Ahahahaha! Good, let me hear more! Let me hear your death cries♪
Amidst the bullets flying every which way and blood spattering about, Sonia was swinging her blades of death about like she was truly singing and dancing.
Each and every time, the screams of gangsters came in torrents. One, and then another, they continued to be slain as glorious tribute.
Ahh, so good! The smell of blood and the sensation of flesh, can't get enough, I'm really feeling it♪ Let me feel it even more♪
Showered by the gangsters' spurting blood, Sonia's face was in ecstasy.
She wasn't merely excited, she was clearly awash in sexual arousal.
Even though the yakuza must have been used to scenes of fighting, they were terrified by the madness of a true bloodthirsty killer.
Aaahnn, what a nice voice. I'm about to come♪
I, too, was horrified to personally lay eyes on this brutal killer.
Oh, now there's only one guy left. How unfortunate.
B-Bastard, which group's agent are you?! Y-You pull a stunt like this on our turf and think you'll get awayー
Sonia casually sliced off the arms of the burly manーmost likely the leader of this groupーwho had tried to put on a brave face at the end.
I'm not in any group. I just came to ask you a little something.
I heard that there will be a black market auction in this city soon. Tell me the time and place.
If you don't know then that's fine. I'll just kill you and ask somebody else.
If you know then say it quickly. Five, four, three, two, oneー
I-It's tomorrow night! The location is the Order of Oryu's secondary meeting place!!
Sonia beheaded the yakuza leader with a smile.
Blood spurted to the ceiling and the boss's head fell to the floor with a thud, wearing a slightly relieved expression, as if he had thought he would be saved.
That was a hell of a way to do it.
In the blink of an eye, the office had become a mountain of corpses. Even if they were yakuza, it was still not a good feeling.
Guys like them, aren't they better off dead?
You looked like you were having fun killing them, though.
Of course I did. I can't help but enjoy it.
Killing is worth more to me than anything else. It's the greatest pleasure, even beyond sex.
I could tell you were getting aroused...
I sighed and sympathized with the evildoers who had become the victims of a brutal killer's pleasure.
Yeah, and I want to thank you for one thing.
You didn't disturb my killing spree. And you didn't try to help me. Thanks to that, I could enjoy the killing on my own.
If you had done something unnecessary, I would have killed you right off the bat, ehehe.
In fact, I just hadn't been able to move at all.
Anyway, with that we had gotten the information regarding the black market auction.
We had infiltrated the black market auction that was being held at the Order of Oryu's secondary meeting place.
Yakuza, mafiosos, hitmen, and brokers. Villains were crowding the place, each with a peculiar trait or two.
So you're a freelance hitman and I'm your lover. Quite a delightful premise.
Sonia said happily, her arms linked with mine.
But... wouldn't the opposite have been better? Me as the hitman and you as the lover.
Your face is known too well. Well, some guys seem to have already recognized you though.
I don't care whether they recognize me or not. Because I'm just gonna kill them if they stand in our way.
Just in case, I'll say it now, but hold off on the killing until the target shows up.
I know. But I have no interest in doing my duty for the UFS.
I'm just really looking forward to the moment when I can slice up that traitor's body little by little. It won't bother me having to wait a little bit for that, ehehe.
Slice him up... Wasn't this mission about securing the researcher?
That's why I'm gonna slice him up nice and sloooowly. So he doesn't die until we get back to the UFS.
...I'm starting to feel bad for this guy.
While continuing to respond to Sonia, I looked around the venue and was able to see Shizuru and Shikanosuke.
But we merely exchanged knowing glances and pretended not to know each other.
For the time being, it was a good idea to do our best to not stand out.
She looked happy... Not because the auction was starting, but because the opportunity to kill was approaching.
In any case, the black market auction started.
The items getting auctioned off one after the other were all contraband that could never be shown to the general public.
It was reported that a new model of UFS combat drone would also be on display here.
And it would even come with the developer included as a package deal. It seemed that it was the featured item of today's auction.
(There's a high likelihood that it's our target... And even if that's not the case, I'm sure he'll show up.)
However, the featured item just wasn't coming out at all.
When I noticed the time, it had been two hours since the start. Sonia's mood was just getting worse and worse.
Hey, be a little bit more patient.
If she started killing random people just to test her weapon, our plan would be ruined.
That's not it. I've had a bad feeling since earlier.
I'd say, It feels like the back of my neck is tingling. I felt the same thing when I stood in front of the electric chair and the UFS suddenly offered me a deal.
In fact I, too, had had a bad feeling since a while back.
The feeling as if we had fallen into some terrible trap.
But I mean, I had been working under the assumption that the UFS was plotting something from the very beginning...
With no regard for our doubts, the auctioneer called out loudly.
Now then, it is finally time for tonight's main item! A new model of combat drone leaked from the UFS. And can you believe it, the offer comes with the developer included!
An individual who looked like our target appeared on the stage.
And with him a large steel chest, several meters tall and wide.
(It's good that he showed up, but is he really the target, Watanabe Suzuki himself?)
With the stage being far away, and his face having no distinguishing features, there was no way I could be certain.
Hey, are you sure that's him? He's too far away, so I can't really tell.
Why don't we just get a closer look.
Sonia said and approached the stage without hesitation.
As expected, the guards tried to stop her, but also as expected, Sonia mowed them down.
Blood gracefully spattered about the auction hall.
I held my head in my hands.
Damn it, did I make her wait too much?
But after getting close enough that she could check the target's face, Sonia said something even more unforeseen.
That's not him... this is bad, huh!?
At that moment, the steel chest suddenly opened up.
Inside it was... not a drone, but fully-armed UFS soldiers.
And they suddenly opened fire from the stage.
The raining bullets were, of course, striking the villains, but they were also coming the way of Sonia, who was supposedly an ally.
The guys close to the stage were instantly flung away like rags.
Sonia had jumped back at the moment the chest had opened, but had still seemingly taken several bullets, and her body was thrown back through the air with a jolt.
I had to hand it to her for not getting turned into swiss cheese from that distance.
I quickly knocked over a table for cover from the bullets, and pulled Sonia behind it as well, since she had luckily fallen down nearby.
A massacre had begun all around us.
The villains were armed as well, but they were no match for an official UFS squad.
The same was true for us. We couldn't fight back in this situation.
(Seeing as we've been surprise-attacked, we need to withdraw from here immediately and regroup...!)
Suddenly, the surroundings were covered with a flurry of sakura petals.
Good. She had blocked us from view.
Amidst the echoing gunfire and screams of agony, we took cover in the sakura, beautiful in how out-of-place they were, and fled.
A short time later, we were hiding in a hotel on the outskirts of the city.
There were few decent human beings in Tokyo Kingdom, but there were plenty of places like this.
However, we had gotten completely separated from Shizuru and Shikanosuke, and I had lost my communication device.
Sonia, whom I had laid on the bed, let out a low moan.
Does it hurt? Let me see the wound.
What? No need to do that.
Sonia looked at me with an annoyed face.
She insisted that she had only been grazed, but I was sure that she had been shot.
But surprisingly, she just pressed down on the wound with her hand, and even without doing any particular treatment, she didn't seem to be in much pain.
It's not like we have anything else to do.
You want to see my wound just to kill time? Ehehe, you've got good taste.
Sonia let out a strangely seductive voice and showed me her wound.
It wasn't just a scratch. It was a pretty deep wound.
Flesh was gouged out, thick blood vessels were torn open, and bone was shattered.
If she were normal, it wouldn't have been strange for her to be dead. Or at least passed out from the pain.
But Sonia's face was completely calm, and her wound was wriggling eerily and recovering at an incredible pace.
This was not at all the body of a human.
Did you think I was a just a human being? The UFS guys messed around with my body so much that it's gotten to the same level as a mid-ranking demon.
But it's been a long time since I was tormented like this♪
Killing someone is my favorite thing, but I don't hate ending up like this myself.
Look, my flesh is gouged this deep and bright red blood is gushing out... Ah, I can really feel it... I can't get enough.
Sonia was entranced by her own wounded body.
It was the same face as when she was killing.
I was appalled, but now that I had seen it I had no choice. I decided to patch her up.
Using the bed sheets, I made an improvised bandage and wrapped it around her wound.
Ehehe, because you're such a busybody.
I've got ointments and painkillers just in case, but you don't need them, right?
Don't make such a weird voice.
Tighten it a bit there, enough so the blood seeps out slowly. Make it hurt even more...
Don't make me participate in your perverse hobby.
Sonia was enjoying the pain, but it was definitely a serious injury. She probably couldn't move properly yet.
The proof of that was her letting me administer treatment as I pleased.
Who the hell were those UFS guys earlier? That wasn't part of the plan. And they even shot you.
Yeah. They definitely tried to kill me.
Don't say that so casually. What's going on?
Sonia chuckled at my question and started to explain.
The UFS is not a monolith. It looks like there was a unit working separately from us. It might even be that they were the main team for this mission.
So you think they tried to kill the runaway researcher and you, a black sheep within the UFS, at the same time?
I'm liked by no one. Many have lost friends and lovers in the wake of my destruction.
It's not like I care about that though.
You reap what you sow. But even so, why did the UFS get us Taimanin involved?
I don't know. Weren't they just thinking I'd ignore my mission and we'd kill each other?
But since we wouldn't kill each other no matter how much time passed, they got fed up and decided to take action themselves?
Most likely. That sounds like something they'd think up.
Damn it. So we were just used as pawns against you...?
I basically spit out my words.
I had thought there were some unknown circumstances, but they had been hopeless circumstances.
Ehehe, you should've just left me and run away.
Sonia peered into my eyes with amusement.
You're a perverted killer, but right now you're on our side. It's not like I can just leave one of my people behind and run away.
Okay then, I'll tell you something nice.
I have a transmitter implanted in my body. Even if we hide, they'll be coming for us soon. You'd better run away quickly.
Why didn't you tell me earlier?!
That was enough to make even me raise my voice.
I want to kill them all. That's why I'm waiting here, ehehe.
Ugh, where is this transmitter or whatever?
Here. But I can't take it out by myself. They implanted that suggestion in my mind.
Sonia pointed amusedly in the area of her right thigh.
I pulled out my dagger without hesitation.
Then I made a deep cut into the right thigh of the puzzled-looking Sonia.
However, it was a sensual voice that came out of her mouth. She seemed even more ecstatic than before.
I mean... I didn't expect... mmhhmm... that you... aahhn... would cut me... like this... aahhh... amaaazing...
There was no other way! Where's the transmitter?!
Her body, which had been modified to the level of a mid-ranking demon, tried to push back the blade as if it had a will of its own.
In order to pull out the buried transmitter, I had to gouge out her flesh with all my might.
Hyaah... mmaahh... good... it's... it's around there... uuuhhh... Gouge it out... spin that dagger... and pull it out...
Her sensual voice had almost made me feel weird as well, but I had finally been able to gouge out the transmitter.
I smashed it immediately and wrapped a bandage around the brand new wound on her thigh.
Let's get out of here right now!
You really have strange tastes, ehehe.
I lifted Sonia up again and this time she clung to me, strangely happy.
However, it seemed that we had been too late. They had already figured out our location long ago.
Barely after we had left the hotel, UFS soldiers appeared.
Oh, what a shame. Looks like we didn't make it out in time.
Sonia said in my arms. She didn't sound like she thought it was a shame at all though.
There were more than ten enemies.
It was a number I couldn't handle on my own. And Sonia, my last ray of hope, was still recovering.
But you still don't intend to leave me and run away, right?
I wish I could! But that goes against my principles!
In that case, put me down. I'd rather die fighting. I'll take as many of them with me as I can by myself.
Sonia seemed to at least be able to walk, but she wouldn't listen to me anyway if I told her to run. I lowered her to the ground.
Come on guys, don't be shy. I'm going to savor this final pleasure♪
Even in the face of certain death, there was a bewitching smile on her face.
And while I knew her as a serial killer, I still thought she was beautiful when I looked at her from the side.
And just before our deadly battle was about to beginー
A curtain of sakura petals spread through the night sky and became a poisonous flower storm that struck the UFS soldiers.
Just in the nick of time, huh.
Fuma, we came to save you!
It was a perfectly timed rescue.
The UFS soldiers were thrown into disarray by the surprise attack from the two of them.
Now that we had escaped the crisis, Sonia nodded her head almost as if bored.
After we had somehow repelled the UFS soldiers, I let out a sigh of relief.
It looks like the UFS set us up.
Shizuru, who had demonstrated her "Shizuru the Flower" specialties, also let out a sigh.
Yes. It seems the mission to secure the runaway researcher was just a pretext and the true goal was killing Sonia and us.
Originally, the UFS probably wanted Sonia and us to kill each other. I imagine.
What's wrong with them. Gimme a break. Damn it!
Don't complain to me. Even I was fooled by them.
Sonia, the root cause of all of this, said with a completely unconcerned expression.
The story about the researcher still bothers me, but we have no obligation to go along with anything beyond this.
Same for me. I don't care about the mission anymore.
Sonia smiled as if to say she had other things to do.
What are you planning to do now?
I'm going to kill, of course. Kill those who set me up.
Her reply was exactly as I had expected.
We especially had no obligation to go with her. It was time to bid her farewell.
She jabbed toward me with her iron claws that were stained with the blood of UFS soldiers.
I've taken a liking to you.
That why I feel like I want to kill you right now. As thanks for slicing open my thigh, ehehe.
The eyes of the Homicidal Maniac shined brilliantly.
